---
title: "Curriculum Vitae"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

```{python}
#| output: asis
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from scripts.helpers import (
    load, load_one, render_publications, render_working_papers,
    render_grants, render_teaching, render_presentations,
    render_editorial, render_service, render_conference_org,
    render_dissemination, _period, _esc
)
from IPython.display import HTML, display

profile      = load_one('profile.yaml')
appointments = load('appointments.yaml')
education    = load('education.yaml')
pubs         = load('publications.yaml')
wps          = load('working_papers.yaml')
grants       = load('grants.yaml')
teaching     = load('teaching.yaml')
presentations = load('presentations.yaml')
editorial    = load('editorial.yaml')
service      = load('service.yaml')
conf_org     = load('conference_org.yaml')
dissemination = load('dissemination.yaml')

# ── Header ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
links = []
if profile.get('email'):
    links.append(f'<a href="mailto:{profile["email"]}">{profile["email"]}</a>')
if profile.get('google_scholar'):
    links.append(f'<a href="{profile["google_scholar"]}">Google Scholar</a>')
if profile.get('orcid'):
    links.append(f'<a href="https://orcid.org/{profile["orcid"]}">ORCID</a>')

display(HTML(
    f'<p style="color:var(--text-muted)">'
    f'{profile.get("position","")} &nbsp;·&nbsp; {profile.get("institution","")}</p>'
    f'<p>{ " &nbsp;·&nbsp; ".join(links) }</p>'
))

# ── Appointments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rows = []
for a in appointments:
    period = _period(a.get('period_start'), a.get('period_end'))
    rows.append(
        f'<div class="cv-entry">'
        f'<span class="cv-entry-year">{period}</span>'
        f'<span><strong>{_esc(a["title"])}</strong>, {_esc(a.get("department",""))}, {_esc(a.get("institution",""))}</span>'
        f'</div>'
    )
display(HTML('<h2>Positions</h2>' + "\n".join(rows)))

# ── Education ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rows = []
for e in education:
    thesis = f', <em>{_esc(e["thesis"])}</em>' if e.get('thesis') else ''
    rows.append(
        f'<div class="cv-entry">'
        f'<span class="cv-entry-year">{e.get("year","")}</span>'
        f'<span><strong>{_esc(e["degree"])}</strong>, {_esc(e.get("institution",""))}{thesis}</span>'
        f'</div>'
    )
display(HTML('<h2>Education</h2>' + "\n".join(rows)))

# ── Research ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display(HTML('<h2>Publications</h2>'    + render_publications(pubs)))
display(HTML('<h2>Working Papers</h2>' + render_working_papers(wps)))

# ── Grants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display(HTML('<h2>Grants & Funding</h2>' + render_grants(grants)))

# ── Teaching ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display(HTML('<h2>Teaching</h2>' + render_teaching(teaching)))

# ── Presentations (most recent 10) ────────────────────────────────────────────
recent = sorted(presentations, key=lambda x: str(x.get('date','')), reverse=True)[:10]
display(HTML('<h2>Selected Presentations</h2>' + render_presentations(recent)))

# ── Service ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display(HTML('<h2>Academic Service</h2>'))
display(HTML('<h3>Editorial & Reviewing</h3>'    + render_editorial(editorial)))
display(HTML('<h3>Departmental Service</h3>'     + render_service(service)))
display(HTML('<h3>Conference Organisation</h3>'  + render_conference_org(conf_org)))

# ── Outreach ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
display(HTML('<h2>Outreach & Dissemination</h2>' + render_dissemination(dissemination)))
```
